read.en: Tesla fell 1.8% on Nov 13 to $390.22, trading $385.83–404.40. It is above the 5-day ($387.3), 10-day ($382.6), 30-day ($381.3), 100-day ($366.6) and 200-day ($382.7); the 5 and 30-day are rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram almost closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 12 ($339.41), and RSI is 53.5.

read.en: No level changed: the $404.40 high cleared $398.5–401.2 intraday but the close fell back under it, while the low held $385.2–388.6. Resistance is $397.5–401.2, then $403.8–406.5 (Nov 2 close, Nov 13 and Nov 3 highs) and $414.2 (Nov 2 high). Support is $385.2–388.6 ($388 cap, Nov 11–13 lows), then $382.6–382.7 (10 and 200-day) and $379.8–381.3. A close above $401.2 would target $404–406.5; below $385.2, $381–383.
